title: Persisted Manifest Recorded-Balance Service
selectedSlice: direct persistence-facing manifest to FOOD-006E resolution to FOOD-006F recorded-balance composition
purpose: Provide one bounded asynchronous orchestration operation that accepts a caller-supplied FOOD-006C manifest, resolves its exact persisted evidence through FOOD-006E, and on complete resolution composes that evidence through FOOD-006F.
rules: The database dependency is supplied explicitly and uses the existing FOOD-006D/006E database contract.
The supplied manifest is passed to FOOD-006E without reinterpretation.
FOOD-006E invalid remains invalid.
FOOD-006E not-found remains not-found.
FOOD-006E storage-failure remains storage-failure.
FOOD-006F is invoked only after FOOD-006E returns resolved.
Successful composition returns the exact FOOD-006F canonical composition value.
A FOOD-006F exception after a resolved FOOD-006E result fails closed as storage-failure because it indicates internal durable/canonical disagreement or schema/program drift.
No partial resolved evidence or partial balances are ever returned.
No retry occurs.
No current, latest, clock or time inference occurs.
The returned composition remains supplied-manifest recorded evidence only.
Manifest provenance remains retained through FOOD-006F.
No evidence completeness or database cutoff is established.
No authoritative current quantity-on-hand is established.
No stock enforcement occurs.
No reservation-aware availability or stocked-capacity authority is established.
No checkout, payment, fulfillment, sale, accounting or rewards authority is established.
No persistence write occurs.
No migration definition changes or migration execution occur.
deferred: Database cutoff or point-in-time snapshot semantics.
